# vivijure.com

> Vivijure: the free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted AI film studio. Stable 1.0.

## Product
- Site: https://vivijure.com
- Demo: https://demo.vivijure.com
- Constellation map: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure
- Control panel (Cloudflare): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-cf
- Control panel (Docker / home / cloud): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-local
- Shared core: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-core
- Agent MCP: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-mcp
- GPU backend (RunPod): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-backend
